guidance: Act3 boss Test Subject #C8 initially shows100 HP, Attack20, Adaptable1 and Enrage2; do not assume one HP bar ends the run. Player HP71/82, Sai Block7, energy4, potions Liquid Bronze/Block/Flex. Verified opening plays Innate Mad Science+ cost1 to gain8 Block and draw3 BEFORE Battle Trance, whose No Draw would otherwise waste that draw. Then inspect fresh hand and displayed intent; seek a safe turn1 line with enough Block against the actual attack after any Enrage change. Cruelty+ and Bash can multiply damage once Vulnerable is applied, but preserving HP and building Barricade+/Pyre+ is higher priority if the boss has multiple phases. Use Block Potion if needed, Liquid Bronze for repeated attacks, Flex Potion for meaningful burst or lethal. Stop after a short segment for expert review; require actual GAME_OVER victory flag.
